title: Strategic Industry–University Collaboration for Advanced Chemical Equipment Technology
category: Chemical Equipment R&D & Advanced Materials Engineering
summary: Tongyang signed a strategic cooperation agreement with a School of Materials Science and Engineering to jointly advance material science, welding, forming technologies and innovation in high-end chemical equipment manufacturing.
body:
Project Background

On June 10, Tongyang signed a strategic cooperation agreement with a School of Materials Science and Engineering in Yangzhou, establishing a framework for long-term collaboration between industry and academia.

The cooperation aims to address key technical challenges in chemical equipment manufacturing and support the company's transformation towards high-end and intelligent manufacturing.

Tongyang's Role & Cooperation Scope

As the industrial partner, Tongyang will work closely with the academic team in the following areas:

  • Joint R&D on advanced materials and manufacturing technologies

  • Technical improvements in welding and metal forming processes

  • Joint laboratory development

  • Industry-oriented talent training

  • Research and development of high-end chemical equipment technologies

The collaboration establishes a foundation for combining academic research capabilities with industrial manufacturing experience, supporting technological innovation and the upgrading of chemical equipment manufacturing.
